nodes.speaker: npc
nodes.text: You came. Good. Sit. Look out there: past the clouds, that's the Layland. Every road, every city, every Cathedral.

nodes.speaker: npc
nodes.text: There are seven of them down there. The Emperors. The strongest beings in the world. Nobody knows where they came from, only that nothing has ever stopped them.

nodes.speaker: npc
nodes.text: Every hero the Benefactor sends is told the same thing: train, grow strong, and one day stand against them. Most never come back to tell me how it went.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: And the secret? You didn't drag me up a mountain to talk about the view.

nodes.speaker: npc
nodes.text: I've been sent to the Cathedrals more times than I can count. Every time I fell, I woke up on that cold floor. And I've never once prayed in one.

nodes.speaker: npc
nodes.text: Remember that. Whatever they tell you about the Benefactor, keep your eyes open. Gifts always come from somewhere.

nodes.speaker: npc
nodes.text: Because you listen. Because... wait. Do you feel that? The wind just stopped.

nodes.speaker: npc
nodes.text: Quiet up here. That's why I like it.
